alternatives.whole_image_idea: Relief at saving the first readable print from a rooftop gust: a woman records a self-portrait beside a slanting line of blue botanical sheets, her spare hand displays one damp sheet secured to a glass support, fallen clips and a puddle make the interruption visible.
alternatives.comparison: Strong sheet-to-face relation and graphic blue rhythm; the unstable glass support needs especially simple safe staging.

alternatives.whole_image_idea: A small repair that restores celebration: a woman records a self-portrait in a carousel restoration bay, her spare hand shows a snapped painted wooden peg while the rejoined mane remains clamped behind her; wood dust and a newly lit test bulb connect breakage to provisional success.
alternatives.comparison: Strong material continuity and human pride, but the broken peg can be too small to read in the single frame.

alternatives.whole_image_idea: The last lantern made ready after a harbor squall: a woman records a self-portrait in a narrow waterfront repair shed, her spare hand lifts the repaired bamboo-and-paper lantern by its handle; the translucent patch, wet drying ropes and an open storm-lit doorway connect the damaged object to relieved delight.
alternatives.comparison: Large recognizable object, readable patch and inviting face can carry the moment; keeping the spare-hand handle contact legible matters.

alternatives.whole_image_idea: Tender victory over an ordinary cold night: a woman records a self-portrait inside a tram converted into a winter greenhouse, her spare hand steadies a small seed tray while a newly taped split window, condensation and loosely wrapped insulating foil reveal the effort to protect the sprouts.
alternatives.comparison: A quiet cause-and-response theme with a distinctive place; multiple glass surfaces could weaken direct-selfie capture ownership.

authorial_capture_choice: direct hand-held ultra-wide self-portrait; not requester-owned camera direction/height
